description: This file defines a custom guardrail class for use with the litellm library, implementing several hooks to modify, validate, or reject API call data and responses.

classes.name: myCustomGuardrail
classes.description: A custom guardrail class extending the base CustomGuardrail, implementing hooks for pre-call, moderation, and post-call processing, primarily designed to mask or reject specific wordings in API data.

methods.name: Optional[Union[Exception,str,dict]] async_pre_call_hook( self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, cache: DualCache, data: dict, call_type: Literal[ "completion", "text_completion", "embeddings", "image_generation", "moderation", "audio_transcription", "pass_through_endpoint", "rerank", "mcp_call", "anthropic_messages", ], )
methods.description: Modifies messages to mask occurrences of 'litellm' before the API call is made.

methods.name: async_moderation_hook( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, call_type: Literal[ "completion", "embeddings", "image_generation", "moderation", "audio_transcription", "responses", "mcp_call", "anthropic_messages", ], )
methods.description: Checks messages for the word 'litellm' and raises ValueError to block calls containing it.
